environment: iPhone 17 iOS simulator development Hermes; same Mac host as Node and Rust comparisons
boundaries: FMD baseline and optimized variants are browser bundles built from the baseline and candidate source with identical esbuild options and tested in the same Hermes runtime, with identical public key/seed pairs. The first sample includes each bundle's cold precomputation.

Complete preview uses the original App SDK/session 1.2.4 with Metro resolving only @invisi-labs/primitives exports to the local candidate build. It uses the same synthetic Note, 16-level path and live broadcaster as the baseline demo.
All chain readers and wallet inventory are fixtures. No real wallet data, private signing key, proof generation or transaction submission is used.
Complete-quote timings already include HTTP and repricing. Network conditions and connection reuse differ between runs; these are development simulator observations, not a device release guarantee.
Measured stage sums exclude fixture setup, the second status lookup in the fixture, cleanup and App integration overhead. They are not a UI end-to-end measurement.
Pure TypeScript performance is improved but has not reached the measured Node/V8 complete-quote timing. No npm publication or production App dependency change has been performed.
